statusReason: The codebase has production Redis and object-storage startup requirements and web worker gating, but the current EC2/Compose topology still includes node-local Redis and MinIO defaults, and ASG secret/bootstrap/rolling-deploy evidence is not proven.

evidence: docker-compose.yml defines a local redis service and defaults REDIS_URL to redis://redis:6379/0.
backend/src/middleware/publicRateLimit.ts uses RedisStore only when Redis is configured; otherwise in-process fallback is per node.
blockers.requiredResolution: Use one shared Redis endpoint per region, such as ElastiCache or a hardened shared Redis node, and inject the same REDIS_URL into every web and worker instance.

evidence: docker-compose.yml defines a local minio service and minio_data volume.
blockers.requiredResolution: Move regional production artifacts to shared S3 or another managed S3-compatible endpoint reachable by all instances. Do not approve ASG while each node owns its own MinIO data volume.

evidence: No ASG user-data, SSM, or Secrets Manager bootstrap path is committed and validated for fresh replacement instances.
blockers.requiredResolution: Define and validate instance-profile access to SSM Parameter Store or Secrets Manager, render backend/.env or container env without printing secrets, and fail boot when required values are missing.

evidence: docker-compose.yml disables RUN_BACKGROUND_WORKERS on backend and enables workers on a separate worker service.
worker.ts starts schedulers and maintenance loops; many use Redis leases, but the compliance pack scheduler itself is not lease-wrapped.
blockers.requiredResolution: Keep web ASG nodes at RUN_BACKGROUND_WORKERS=false. Run one separate worker service per region for singleton jobs, or add a Redis/database distributed lock around every scheduler before scaling workers.

evidence: ALBs are healthy, but no ASG instance refresh policy, deregistration delay, warmup, or rollback automation has been applied.
ASG creation and attachment are explicitly out of scope for this audit.
blockers.requiredResolution: Before ASG apply, approve a rolling policy with max unavailable 1, min healthy capacity 100 percent, ALB target deregistration delay, warmup/grace values, and a rollback path.

conditionsBeforeReaudit: Production DNS remains rolled back to London EC2 until a separate approved DNS cutover.
Redis is external/shared per region and not container-local per EC2 node.
Object storage is shared per region and not container-local MinIO per EC2 node.
Migrations are run as an explicit one-shot release step, not by every booting instance.
Secrets are injected through IAM-authenticated SSM or Secrets Manager bootstrap with no secret values in logs.
Fresh instance bootstrap is repeatable from image, user data, env, and repository scripts.
ALB health checks use /healthz for shallow liveness or /api/health/ready for dependency readiness according to the rollout phase.
Rolling deploy and rollback behavior are documented and tested against regional test records.
operatorInputsRequiredForConditionalRead: Per-region OBJECT_STORAGE_BUCKET and OBJECT_STORAGE_REGION/AWS_REGION, plus either IAM instance-profile access or static custom endpoint credentials.
Documented SSM Parameter Store or Secrets Manager paths for all backend production secrets.
Launch-template user data or bootstrap script that installs/runs the same Docker image and env on a clean instance.
Worker topology decision: one singleton worker, lease-protected workers, or no workers on web ASG nodes.
Approved ASG health check grace period, target warmup, deregistration delay, and instance refresh policy.
